text:
ting: Quick heads up — fsck on scratchpool nodes in ap-southeast1 showing repeated journal replay errors after nightly batch window. Suspect interleaved writes from cleaner + janitor. Logs attached.

sam: which cohort? node ids?

ting: cohort 2TB-021, nodes gnode-apse1-{12,13,14}

kevin: saw similar on gnode-13 earlier today, reboots fixed temporarily. paste of journal head:
```
[  123.456] EXT4-fs error (device nvme0n1p1): ext4_journal_check_start: Detected aborted journal
[  123.457] EXT4-fs (nvme0n1p1): Remounting filesystem read-only
```

maria: @kevin any correlation with cleaner tasks? janitor schedule ran at 02:00 UTC.

kevin: yes janitor ran a deep-scan at 02:03, cleaner started aggressive trim/evict at 02:05. I think writeback + trim raced.

ting: I pulled kernel oops from gnode-14, looks like write ordering got violated during eviction — snippet:
```
call trace: __blk_mq_complete, blk_finish_request
journal: commit(0x8f...) failed
```

storage-bot: Alert created: STORAGE-APE-2987. Investigating.

sam: short-term: can we throttle janitor/cleaner on cohort 2TB-021? will reduce GPU attach failures.

ting: yes, proposed throttle:
```
curl -XPOST http://janitor.api/adjust -d '{"cohort":"2TB-021","rate":0.3}'
```

kevin: done. rate set to 0.3. monitoring CPU/iops.

maria: cost note — throttling will delay reclaim, might increase storage footprint ~5% for 12h. ok to proceed?

sam: yes choose availability over reclamation. :thumbsup:

ting: I'll follow up with a postmortem if we see further corruption. For now tickets: STORAGE-APE-2987, NVME-DEPLOY-442.

janitor-bot: scheduled rollback of deep-scan to 03:00 UTC in 5m.

ting: thanks. keeping channel updated.
